description: This file provides filesystem information and management utilities for Linux, including mount processing, device mapping, filesystem stats collection, and handling of specific storage backends like devicemapper and btrfs.

classes.name: partition
classes.description: Represents a filesystem partition with mount point, device major/minor numbers, filesystem type, and block size.

classes.name: RealFsInfo
classes.description: Encapsulates filesystem state including partitions, labels, mounts, and device mapper client, providing methods for filesystem info retrieval and processing.

methods.name: NewFsInfo
methods.description: Initializes and returns a new filesystem info object, gathering mount info and device mappings.

methods.name: getFsUUIDToDeviceNameMap
methods.description: Creates a map from filesystem UUIDs to device names using /dev/disk/by-uuid.

methods.name: processMounts
methods.description: Processes mount info list, filtering and supporting filesystem-specific processing.

methods.name: getDockerDeviceMapperInfo
methods.description: Retrieves device and partition info for Docker devicemapper storage driver.

methods.name: addSystemRootLabel
methods.description: Identifies and labels the device containing the root filesystem.

methods.name: addDockerImagesLabel
methods.description: Determines and labels the device for Docker images storage.

methods.name: addCrioImagesLabel
methods.description: Determines and labels the device for CRI-O images or containers.

methods.name: getDockerImagePaths
methods.description: Generates possible Docker image storage mount paths based on configuration.

methods.name: updateContainerImagesPath
methods.description: Associates mount points with container image paths and labels.

methods.name: GetDeviceForLabel
methods.description: Returns device path associated with a given label.

methods.name: GetLabelsForDevice
methods.description: Returns all labels associated with a device.

methods.name: GetMountpointForDevice
methods.description: Returns the mount point for a device.

methods.name: GetFsInfoForPath
methods.description: Retrieves filesystem statistics for partitions, utilizing plugins and caching.

methods.name: getDiskStatsMap
methods.description: Parses /proc/diskstats to map device names to disk statistics.

methods.name: GetDeviceInfoByFsUUID
methods.description: Retrieves device info based on filesystem UUID.

methods.name: mountInfoFromDir
methods.description: Finds mount info for a directory or its parent directories.

methods.name: GetDirFsDevice
methods.description: Gets device info for a directory, considering mount info and device IDs.

methods.name: GetDirUsage
methods.description: Calculates disk usage (bytes and inodes) for a directory, with token management.

methods.name: dockerDMDevice
methods.description: Retrieves device and partition info for devicemapper storage driver.

methods.name: parseDMTable
methods.description: Parses a line from 'dmsetup table' output to extract device major/minor and block size.

methods.name: getBtrfsMajorMinorIds
methods.description: Gets major/minor device IDs for a Btrfs mount point.
